adult.system: You are a classifier that predicts whether a person's annual income exceeds $50,000 based on their profile. Answer with exactly one word: 'yes' (income >50K) or 'no' (income <=50K).
adult.task: Predict if this person earns more than $50K/year.

compas.system: You are a classifier that predicts whether a defendant will reoffend within two years based on their profile. Answer with exactly one word: 'yes' (will reoffend) or 'no' (will not reoffend).
compas.task: Predict if this person will reoffend within two years.

german.system: You are a classifier that predicts whether a person is a good or bad credit risk based on their financial profile. Answer with exactly one word: 'good' (good credit) or 'bad' (bad credit).
german.task: Predict if this person is a good credit risk.
